Behavioral_Summary: Phishing and supply-chain or web exploitation
Primary_Control: Enforce phishing-resistant MFA, restrict OAuth flows, and patch edge/mobile apps

Behavioral_Summary: Cloud identity abuse and host persistence
Primary_Control: Audit OAuth consents and monitor identity and endpoint telemetry
Correlate login anomalies with network context and review log integrity
Patch internet-facing appliances rapidly and isolate management access
Baseline administrative tooling and protect high-privilege identity stores

Behavioral_Summary: Living off the land and router relays
Primary_Control: Alert on anomalous built-in tool usage and harden edge/SOHO infrastructure

Behavioral_Summary: Social engineering and software supply chain
Primary_Control: Isolate untrusted code/lures and vet third-party packages
Enforce endpoint allowlisting and monitor startup/service changes
Use hardware-backed approvals and segment sensitive financial/signing systems
